paite: Huailouin Elihuin a dawnga, hichiin a chi a:
english: Moreover Elihu answered,

paite: Ka thute ja un, nou mi pilte; nou theihna neite, bil hondoh un.
english: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.

paite: Dangtawngin ann achiam bangin, bilin thute a enchain hi.
english: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.

paite: A dik eia dingin I tel ding uh; I lak ua hoih bang ahia I thei ding uh.
english: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.

paite: Job in lah, Ka dika, huan Pathianin ka dikna a la mang, a chi ngala:
english: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right:

paite: Ka dikna huchin hita mahleh juautheia sim ka hia; tatlekna bei himahleng, ka liamna hihdam theihlouh ahi.
english: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’

paite: Muhsitna tui banga dawn bei, Job bang mihing kua ahia?
english: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,

paite: Thulimlou nasemmite toh a hona pai, mi giloute toh om khawmmi.
english: Who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

paite: Aman lah, Pathian laka ka kipahna ding bangmah ka lohtak kei, a chi ngala.
english: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’

paite: Huaijiakin, nou theisiammite, honngaikhia un: Pathianin, gilou bangchiin a hih ngei mahmah dia; huan Thilbangkimhihtheiin thulimlou bangchiin a hih mahmah dia.
english: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

paite: Aman lah mihing thilhih amah kianga pe kik ding hi ngala, huan mi chiteng a lampite kianga pekik ding ahi.
english: For the work of a man he will render to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

paite: A hi, mohkhuksakna thu ah, Pathianin giloutakin a hih kei dia, Thilbangkimhihtheiin leng vaihawmna a hihse sam kei ding hi.
english: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

paite: Kuan ahia amah leitunga heututna pia? Ahihkeileh khovel pumpi kuan ahia a thua koih?
english: Who put him in charge of the earth? or who has appointed him over the whole world?

paite: Mihing tunga a lungtang a ngaka, amah lama a kha leh a hu a lakkhawm leh;
english: If he set his heart on himself, If he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,

paite: Sa tengteng a mangthang khawm ding ua, huan mihing leivui a suak nawn ding hi.
english: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.

paite: Theihsiamna na neih leh, hiai ja in: ka thute aw ngaikhia in.
english: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.

paite: Mi thudik huaiin vai a hawm ding hia? Huan dik leh hat amah na mohpaih ding hia?
english: Shall even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty?—

paite: Kumpipa kianga, Na hoih kei chih a kilawm hia? Ahihkeileh miliante kianga, Na gilou uh? Chih.
english: Who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?

paite: Mi lalte mi hinna zahtak loua, mi genthei sanga mi hausate limsak zote kianga chih kilawm sem lou ding hia? Amaute tengteng lah a khut nasep ahi ngal ua.
english: Who doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respects the rich more than the poor; for they all are the work of his hands.

paite: Mitphiat kallouin a si ua jankim lai mahmahin; mite a ling ua a pai mang ua, mihingkhut hilouin mihatte lakmangin a om uhi.
english: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.

paite: A mitte lah mihing lampite tungah a oma, huan a painate tengteng a mu hi.
english: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.

paite: Thulimlou nasemmite buk theihna ding, khomial a omkei a, sihna limliap leng a om sam kei hi.
english: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

paite: Vaihawmna a Pathian maa a pai dingin, mihing a ngaihtuah lailai a kiphamoh ngal keia.
english: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.

paite: Lamte theihphak vual louhin aman mi hatte a hihjan veka, a mun uah midangte a tungkhia hi.
english: He breaks in pieces mighty men in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.

paite: Huaijiakin a nasepte uh a thei hi; janin amau a lumleta, huchiin hihsiatin a om uhi.
english: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

paite: Midang mitmuh mahmahin mi giloute bangin amau a gawt hi.
english: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

paite: Amah zuihna akipan a pialkhiak ua, a lampitea a koi mahmah a limsaklouh jiakun:
english: because they turned aside from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,

paite: Huchiin genthei kahna a kiang tung dingin a bawl ua, huan gimthuak kahna a ja hi.
english: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.

paite: Amah napau kei leh, huchiin kuan siamlouh a tangsak dia? huan aman a mai a sel leh, huchiin amah kuan a mu thei dia? namte kianga hih hiam, ahihkeileh, mihing kianga hih hiam zong a kibang hi:
english: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? Alike whether to a nation, or to a man,

paite: Huchia pathiantheilou min vai a hawm louha, huchia mite thanga awksak ding kuamah a omlouhna dingin.
english: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.

paite: Kuapeuhin Pathian kiangah, Gawtna ka thuakta, ka gilou nawn kei ding,
english: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.

paite: Ka muh louh nang honsinsak in: gilou ka hih aleh ka hih nawn kei ding, a chi uhia?
english: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?

paite: A thukna na deih bangin a om diam, huchia na nial? Kei hilouin, nang na tel ngeingei ding lah ahi ngala.
english: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.

paite: Theisiammiten ka kiangah, A hi, a chi ding uh, a honja mi pil chitengin,
english: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:

paite: Jobin theihna beiin thu a gena, huan a thute pilna bei ahi uh.
english: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’

paite: Mihaite banga a dawnna thu ah, a tawp chiangin Job tungtang ngaihtuah le uh.Aman lah a khelhna ah helna a behlapa, I lak uah a khut a benga, Pathian kalhin a thute a pungsakta ngala.
english: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.

paite: Aman lah a khelhna ah helna a behlapa, I lak uah a khut a benga, Pathian kalhin a thute a pungsakta ngala.
english: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”
